_comment: Seed labeled query set for the KB search eval harness (graph task #173 §5/§8). Graded relevance 0-3 (3=perfect, 1=marginal). Tiny by design — grow toward 30-100 queries before tuning any tier. The corpus here is a self-contained fixture so `npm run eval` works offline; pass --gid to score against a live graph instead. This frozen set is what every later tier (vector → BM25 → rerank → graph expansion) gets A/B'd against.

corpus.title: Cookie-based session storage
corpus.description: Move auth from Authorization header to httpOnly secure cookies
corpus.body: Wrap the session middleware so reads come from Set-Cookie instead of the bearer header. Covers login, refresh, and logout flows.

corpus.title: Audit token usage
corpus.description: Find every call site reading the session token
corpus.body: Grep the auth middleware for header reads. Several API routes call the middleware directly and will need the new cookie-aware helper.

corpus.title: Rate limiting middleware
corpus.body: Token bucket per IP. Store counters in Postgres. Return 429 with Retry-After when the bucket empties.

corpus.title: pgvector HNSW index
corpus.description: Dense vector search for semantic retrieval
corpus.body: Add an embedding column on tasks and an HNSW index. Tune ef_search per session before rebuilding. Cosine distance over BGE-M3 vectors.

corpus.title: BM25 lexical search
corpus.description: Real BM25 over node content, not vanilla ts_rank
corpus.body: ts_rank lacks IDF and length normalization. Use a proper BM25 extension so the lexical leg has document-length-aware scoring.

corpus.title: Cross-encoder reranker
corpus.description: Rerank the top candidates for precision
corpus.body: bge-reranker-v2-m3 scores query-document pairs. Rerank only the top 20-50 fused hits. The single biggest accuracy lever in the pipeline.

corpus.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion
corpus.description: Fuse lexical and dense candidate lists
corpus.body: RRF with k=60 merges the BM25 and vector rankings without score normalization. Rank-based, robust, and parameter-light.

corpus.title: Graph expansion over edges
corpus.body: Seed from the reranked hits, then traverse the existing edges table k hops, or run Personalized PageRank. We already have the graph, so no LLM extraction.

corpus.title: Kanban view
corpus.description: Group tasks by status into columns
corpus.body: Drag a card between columns to PATCH its status. Edges hidden in this view. Per-user view preference in localStorage.

corpus.title: Presence and selection
corpus.description: Show who is editing what on the live canvas
corpus.body: Each writer posts a selection anchor over SSE. Avatars appear in the top-right bar. Idle presence is reaped after 30 minutes.

corpus.title: Agent tokens
corpus.description: Attribute agent writes to a user
corpus.body: Generate a gt_ prefixed token in the settings panel. The server routes by prefix: gt_ is an agent token, eyJ is a Clerk session JWT.

corpus.title: Optimistic concurrency merge
corpus.body: PATCH sends base_version and base_content. The server merges so a node's x/y position and color survive an agent rewrite that omits them.
